answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade. A single identity that cheats loses its stake, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs real money each time. A public registry, call it Nebula, lists each agent stake and history. Agents earn an Onyx badge after months of honest work, and a Marble score that drops fast after one proven fraud. Attackers then pay more to create fakes than they can steal, and honest agents keep a record anyone can check.
